selected_experts.reason: Primary verification of class identity and taxonomic correctness of the flower structure.
To check for edge bleeding between petals and background, and fusion issues between the insect and the flower center.
To assess texture consistency of the disc florets and detect any subtle AI-generated smoothing or noise patterns.
To identify the secondary subject (insect) and ensure it is structurally coherent and not a hallucinated artifact.

focus_areas: Texture granularity of the yellow disc florets
Edge sharpness between white petals and green background
Structural integrity of the insect on the center
Symmetry and natural variation of petal arrangement
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the insect and the flower center. AI often struggles with small objects resting on complex textures, leading to 'melting' or lack of contact shadows. Verify if the insect looks physically grounded or pasted on. Also, check if the petal tips show any unnatural transparency or blurring.
